title: Filter countries by starting letter
description: Write a function `filter_starts_with(countries, prefix)` that returns the countries whose name starts with `prefix`, using `filter()`.
hints: Method to consider: str.startswith(), inside a filter() lambda

c.startswith(prefix) answers 'does this name start with prefix' per country - the same method used for this in Day 4's string exercises, now driving a filter() instead of being called on a single string.
expected_behavior: Returns the countries whose name starts with prefix.
solution:
def filter_starts_with(countries, prefix):
    return list(filter(lambda c: c.startswith(prefix), countries))
explanation: startswith() inside the filter lambda works exactly like it did as a standalone string method - filter() is just the loop that applies it to every item and keeps the True ones.
